phases.name: terminal-compilation
phases.objects: C++ command g++ -O3 madhav.cpp -o future; ai_infra.cpp/fullstack.cpp/500+solutions bars and ok; ./future typing
phases.mechanism: Native per-character colored text, three staggered ten-unit bars and live cursor.

phases.name: terminal-particle-collapse-flare
phases.objects: Text dissolves and turns into hot cloud, horizontal lens flare and expanding ring
phases.mechanism: 5000 native points converge into a rotating core; cached white/teal glow bitmaps stretch and expanding geometry, no reference-frame playback.

phases.name: 01-ai-infrastructure
phases.objects: 75 glowing interconnected nodes and1400fine field points, AI INFRASTRUCTURE title
phases.mechanism: 6200point native cloud forms the custom network; pulsing nodes and neighbor-distance network lines; dissolves to central cloud.

phases.name: 02-full-stack
phases.objects: Four diamond layers UI/API/DATA/INFRA with vertical signals and FULL-STACK title
phases.mechanism: Custom four-layer projected geometry with slight native rotation; repeated particle transition retains object order.

phases.name: 03-multi-agent-systems
phases.objects: One central particle sphere,6colored small agent spheres, elliptical network,23travelling fragments
phases.mechanism: Per-sphere native Fibonacci points, orbit packets, connecting lines and observed labels.

phases.name: 04-zero-knowledge-security
phases.objects: Particle shackle and rectangular lock body, bright keyhole, circular tick-ring
phases.mechanism: 1400points distributed separately across shackle/body plus native outline and keyhole; ring rotates subtly.

phases.name: 05-problems
phases.objects: 505mini three-bar code cells on diagonally tilted plane,500+PROBLEMS title
phases.mechanism: Deterministic irregular cell positions and projection skew with travelling wave, sampled own geometry for cloud morph.

phases.name: 06-students
phases.objects: 4320points in a deep curved field;100K+STUDENTS count and classroom labels
phases.mechanism: Native perspective point rows/two half-ellipses and eased editable student count.

phases.name: 07-national-tournaments
phases.objects: 16initial bracket entries become8/4/2branches and central final sphere
phases.mechanism: Dedicated symmetric tournament topology, cached moving warm pulses, particle final sphere and ray geometry.

phases.name: 08-papers-production
phases.objects: Perspective paper.pdf with curve and tiny text; four-stackproductionrack and data transfer columns
phases.mechanism: Own paper/rack paths, cached blooms,140native data markers; chapter transition sampled own source.

phases.name: particle-vortex-flare
phases.objects: White/teal spiral collapses to bright thin horizontal flare
phases.mechanism: 6300native points with changing radial distribution, cached wide glows and expanding ring.

phases.name: madhav-brand-lockup
phases.objects: Wide angularMADHAV, outlined ghost word, role, typewriter italic tagline andgithuburl
phases.mechanism: Native M/A/D/H/V vector outlines and editable font fallback, clip reveal, timed role/tagline/url drawing; independent fine points behind name.

phases.name: closing-shutter
phases.objects: Name compresses into thin horizontal line then black
phases.mechanism: Shrinking central clip, native line and final black field.
